text: The eliminator for a finite type Fin n gives:
choices: a way to list all elements of Fin n
a way to define functions by cases on {0,…,n-1} without runtime bounds errors
a proof that Fin n has exactly n elements
a proof that Fin n ≅ ℕ
explanation: Fin n is the type of naturals < n. The eliminator ensures safe array indexing: Vec A n → Fin n → A is total and cannot be out-of-bounds.
